title: Khao Moo Daeng – Thai Red BBQ Pork with Rice

items: Pork shoulder or neck – 1 kg (well-marbled, tender)
Red food coloring – a drop (optional, for authentic color)
Tomato paste – 1 tsp (for depth and color)
Cornstarch slurry – 2 tsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water
Thai jasmine rice – rinse well, steam until fluffy.
Soft-boiled egg (6 minutes, slightly runny yolk)
Chinese sausage (lap cheong) – steamed and sliced thin
Optional: crispy pork belly slices for texture contrast

instructions.title: 1. Moo Daeng (BBQ Red Pork)
steps: Slice pork into long strips (~4 cm thick).
Mix marinade, coat pork, cover, and refrigerate 6–12 hours.
Roast at 200°C (390°F) for 20 minutes, basting with marinade every 10 minutes.
Lower heat to 160°C (320°F) and roast for another 20–25 minutes until caramelized.
Rest, then slice thinly for serving.

instructions.title: 2. Nam Daeng (Red Sauce)
steps: Heat drippings in saucepan, add sauces, sugar, spices, and stock.
Simmer 10–15 minutes until glossy.
Adjust sweetness/saltiness (sauce should be rich, slightly sweet, with umami depth).
Thicken with cornstarch slurry. Strain for a smooth, restaurant-quality finish.

instructions.title: 3. Rice
steps: Use Thai jasmine rice – rinse well, steam until fluffy.
Keep warm for plating.

instructions.title: 4. Accompaniments & Garnish
steps: Prepare fresh cucumber slices.
Julienne the scallions.
Steam and slice the Chinese sausage if using.
Cook a soft-boiled egg (6 minutes) and halve it.
Prepare crispy pork belly slices if using.

instructions.title: 5. Plating (Restaurant Style)
steps: Mold jasmine rice in a neat dome on the plate.
Arrange Moo Daeng slices fanned out across rice.
Add a few slices of Chinese sausage and crispy pork belly.
Place half a soft-boiled egg neatly.
Spoon glossy red sauce generously over the meat, leaving rice partly exposed.
Garnish with cucumber slices, cilantro sprigs, and scallion julienne.
Optional: serve with chili-vinegar dipping sauce on the side for acidity.

tips: Charcoal roasting adds authentic smokiness if possible. Glazing pork with diluted honey in the last 5 minutes gives professional shine.
Sauce should have silky texture – strain for refinement.
Balance is crucial: slightly sweet pork + savory-salty sauce + fresh cucumbers + soft rice.
